top_signals.title: India Jewelers Hold Off Gold Buying, Betting Prices Will Drop
top_signals.summary: Indian jewelers are holding back gold purchases ahead of their busiest demand season, betting that a recent drop in prices has further to run, according to the country’s biggest precious metals refiner.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Joint statement by High Representative/Vice-President Kallas and Commissioner Kos on the early parliamentary elections in Serbia
top_signals.summary: European Commission Statement Brussels, 27 Oct 2026 On Sunday 25 October, the people of Serbia turned out in historic numbers to make their voices heard. Voters have given the next government a strong mandate for change. We look forward to seeing this being realised in practice.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
